template.title: AC Tune-Up Houston & Katy TX — $89 Before May 15
template.summary: AC tune-up in Houston — and if you're in Katy, your system just hit its first 86°F day of the year and the weak parts are starting to show. Our $89 pre-summer tune-up covers a full 21-point inspection: refrigerant leak check, capacitor reading, condenser coil clean, blower amp draw, drain line flush, and thermostat calibration. 75 Degree AC has serviced Katy, Cinco Ranch, and Fulshear since 2016 — all major brands, licensed TACLA, fully insured. Offer good through May 15, 2026. Book before the summer rush starts.
